summary: The PR addresses the issue by adding specific multiplication rules for the Dagger and IdentityOperator classes. It passes all tests but could benefit from some minor style improvements.

issues.description: The import statements within methods can be moved to the top of the file to follow Python conventions.
The `__rmul__` method in `IdentityOperator` simply calls `__mul__`, which could be made clearer by adding a comment explaining why this is done.
